capabilities: Show Claude usage windows as rings in the status bar
Poll the Claude OAuth usage endpoint at a set interval
Colour rings and show a warning glyph at configurable thresholds
Display reset times and last-fetch time on hover or click
Refresh usage on demand via a command
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+). Relies on an undocumented Anthropic API endpoint that may break without notice; plugin fails closed with backoff. Manual install or via BRAT. Requests filesystem, shell (macOS keychain) and network permissions, which the README explains. Not staff-reviewed.
problem: Obsidian gives no visibility into how much of a Claude subscription's usage windows have been consumed while working in the vault.

relations.evidence: reads the OAuth token from the Claude Code credentials file (or the login keychain on macOS)

summary: Status bar plugin that shows Claude subscription usage (5-hour and weekly windows) as rings with percentages and time until reset.
